source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U11: Distinguish specialist debt recovery from a general civil claim and insolvency jurisdiction

facts.statement: RDB framework establishes specialist tribunals for bank/FI debt recovery; insolvency functions arise under their separate legal basis. Book has conflicting commencement/name-change narrative; no date assessment authored.

payload.title: Choose the legal proceeding before selecting its forum
payload.core_explanation_md:
The RDB framework provides a specialist route for adjudication and recovery of the described bank and financial-institution debts. A recovery application asks for the debt to be determined and collected. An insolvency application has a different statutory purpose, eligibility and proceeding structure, even when an institution also performs functions under that legislation.

Do not select a forum only because the claimant uses the word bank or the respondent is insolvent. Establish the applicant category, debt, amount, jurisdiction and remedy. The courseware constitutional discussion concerns the validity of creating the specialist framework; its inconsistent historical date statements are retained as an editorial issue rather than converted into questions.

self_check.prompt_text: Are debt recovery and insolvency interchangeable applications?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. They need separate legal bases and conditions.

payload.stem_md: A branch proposes to reuse a debt-recovery application unchanged as an insolvency filing solely because the customer cannot pay. Which step is needed?

options.text_md: Identify the distinct remedy, eligibility and applicable forum before drafting the application
options.explanation_md: Financial distress alone does not make the two proceedings interchangeable.
A new heading does not establish substantive requirements.

options.text_md: Assume every recovery certificate is already an insolvency admission order
Use the larger collateral value as the only forum criterion
options.explanation_md: Forum depends on statutory conditions, not merely collateral size.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Financial distress alone does not make the two proceedings interchangeable.

payload.stem_md: A source has two inconsistent historical commencement statements. What is the appropriate authoring treatment?

options.text_md: Turn both into alternative correct answers
options.explanation_md: Conflicting facts do not become valid assessment keys.

options.text_md: Choose the later-looking sentence without evidence
Retain the conflict in evidence and omit an unsupported date question
options.explanation_md: The question bank must not invent certainty.

options.text_md: Silently replace the year from memory
options.explanation_md: A remembered year is not retained primary evidence.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The question bank must not invent certainty.
